topic: Splitting rent 50/50 on unequal incomes isn't actually fair -- the math on splitting by income percentage instead
title: Why Splitting Rent 50/50 Is Actually Unfair
description:
You think splitting rent down the middle is the fairest way to do it? The math says you're wrong. If you and your partner have different incomes, a 50/50 split creates a hugely unequal burden.
